response.sql: SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS diff FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with NULL link_to_event form their own group (not excluded); the overall mean of remaining is taken over all budget lines with non-null remaining.
Events are identified by budget.link_to_event; no join to the event table is needed.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude budget lines with no event (NULL link_to_event) from the per-event groups.
alternatives.sql: SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS diff FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
